title: Design System: Oliver Kiran Brown — Personal Site

nav.purpose: Header bar's own font-size context (1.2rem). Nav links and social icons sit at this size; the logo's 1.4em is relative to it.

logo.purpose: Header home-link only. The single display/serif moment in the system. Literata (variable, weight 200), chosen to replace DM Serif Text since that font is an overused training-data default. Renders at ~1.68rem because 1.4em compounds on the 1.2rem nav context.

body.purpose: All prose. System sans stack so the writing carries the page, not the font.

label.purpose: Quiet metadata/tag/widget text. Post dates use a tighter 0.8125em variant of this role.

components.name: Header Bar
components.description: Full-width Sage Olive bar carrying the wordmark, nav, and social icons.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-header { color: #ffffff; display: flex; gap: 1em; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; background-color: #687a3f; font-size: 1.2rem; padding: 1em; width: 100%; } .ds-home-link { font-size: 1.4em; font-weight: 200; font-family: 'Literata', serif; color: #ffffff; } .ds-home-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: .5em 1em; padding: 0; margin: 0; list-style: none; align-items: center; font-size: 1em; } .ds-nav a { color: #ffffff; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { text-decoration: underline; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Default in-body link styling with hover/active/visited states.
components.css: .ds-link { color: #082840; text-decoration: none; } .ds-link:visited { color: #17050f; } .ds-link:hover, .ds-link:active { color: #5f2b48; text-decoration: underline; }

components.name: Blockquote
components.description: Manuscript-style quote: italic + indent, no side-stripe border (the site's absolute ban on colored border-left/right accents).

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Flat gray pill used for post tags.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-transform: capitalize; font-style: italic; background: #f0f0f0; padding: 0.2em 0.5em; border-radius: 4px; text-decoration: none; color: #333; } .ds-tag:hover { background: #dddddd; }

components.name: Code Block
components.description: Block code surface with syntax-highlighted tokens.
components.css: .ds-code { background: #f6f8fa; color: #24292e; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 6px; margin: 1em 0; overflow-x: auto; font-family: Consolas, Menlo, Monaco, monospace; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Post List Row
components.description: A single entry in a list of posts: number, title, date, tags, no card wrapper.
components.html: • 3.Post title goes hereJuly 2026
components.css: .ds-postlist-item { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; margin-bottom: 1em; list-style: none; } .ds-post-number { font-weight: bold; color: #333333; min-width: 2ch; } .ds-postlist-date { font-size: 0.8125em; color: #333333; margin-left: 1.7rem; } .ds-postlist-link { font-size: 1.1875em; font-weight: 700; padding-left: .25em; padding-right: .5em; color: #082840; text-decoration: none; } .ds-postlist-link:hover { color: #5f2b48; text-decoration: underline; }

components.name: Reading Progress
components.description: Fixed 3px bar at the top of the viewport tracking scroll depth. Post pages only. Animates via transform: scaleX(), never width.
components.css: .ds-reading-progress { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 3px; background-color: #687a3f; transform: scaleX(0.4); transform-origin: left; }

narrative.overview: This is a working notebook, not a designed brand page. Every visual decision defers to the writing: one narrow content column, one serif flourish on the wordmark, one accent color, and otherwise plain system-default type on a plain white page. There is no visual performance of authority — no dashboards of stats, no card grids, no gradients — because the site's entire claim is earnestness: this is someone thinking in public, not a polished portfolio funnel. The green top bar and serif logo are the one deliberate flourish; everything below it is quiet by design, in the spirit of references like y1d2.com and neelnanda.io. This system explicitly rejects the generic "data scientist portfolio" template: no hero-metric stat blocks, no identical icon-plus-heading card grids, no gradient accents, no glassmorphism. The plainness is the point, not a placeholder for a future redesign.
keyCharacteristics: A single sage-olive accent carries all brand color; nothing else competes with it.
Flat by default — no shadows, no cards, no layered surfaces.
One serif accent (the wordmark) against otherwise plain system sans body text.
Narrow, centered content column (max-width: 40em) so long-form writing stays comfortable to read.
Header/nav text and icons are always white; hover is signaled by underline or scale, never a dimmer color.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Sage Olive is the only saturated color on the page. It appears on the header bar, one interactive checked-state, and the reading-progress bar; it never appears as decoration, gradient, or a second competing brand hue.

rules.name: The White-on-Accent Rule
rules.body: Header/nav text and icons are always white, never dimmed on hover/active (any shade darker than pure white drops below the 4.5:1 this background needs) — hover is signaled by underline (links) or a small scale-up (social icons), not a color shift.

rules.name: The Invisible Body Rule
rules.body: Body text uses the system font stack, not a licensed webfont. The only place a "chosen" typeface appears is the wordmark; everywhere else, type should get out of the way of the words.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow anywhere in the system. Separation between elements is handled with a 1px dashed hairline (border-top: 1px dashed #e0e0e0) or whitespace, never a shadow.

dos: Do keep Sage Olive (#687a3f) as the single accent color — header bar, one checked-state, and the reading-progress bar only.
Do keep body copy in the system sans stack; reserve Literata for the wordmark alone.
Do use a 1px dashed hairline (#e0e0e0) for section separation instead of shadows or cards.
Do keep the content column narrow (~40em) so long-form writing stays comfortable to read.
Do let plainness read as a feature: an earnest, understated, first-draft voice, not a polished personal-brand funnel.
Do keep header/nav text white; signal hover with underline or scale, never a dimmer color.
Do animate transform/opacity for scroll- or hover-linked motion, never width/height.
donts: Don't introduce hero-metric stat blocks, gradient accents, or glassmorphism — explicit anti-references from PRODUCT.md.
Don't build identical icon-plus-heading card grids for projects, writing, or notes; a plain list row is the established pattern.
Don't add a second saturated brand color; if a new accent is genuinely needed, it must justify displacing Sage Olive's exclusivity, not sit alongside it.
Don't add box-shadows, card elevation, or hover-lift effects — the system is flat by rule, not by omission.
Don't style the wordmark's serif treatment onto body text or headings; Literata is reserved for the logo.
Don't use a colored border-left/border-right as a side-stripe accent (blockquotes now use italics + indent only, no stripe).
Don't dim header/nav text on hover; any shade darker than white fails 4.5:1 on Sage Olive.
